settings.text: Minimum 12 suits in total. Mix any designs and colours freely.

settings.title: New designs every season
settings.text: Winter cotton, khaddar, lawn, chiffon and organza embroidered suits.

settings.title: Delivery across Pakistan
settings.text: Shipped with PostEx from Lahore to every city, with a tracking number for each parcel.

settings.title: Pay in advance or COD
settings.text: Pay in advance by bank transfer, or cash on delivery (COD) when the parcel arrives.

settings.title: Browse designs
settings.text: Every design and its wholesale price is open to everyone. No login needed to look.

settings.title: Choose colours
settings.text: Pick a quantity for each colour. Minimum 12 suits for the whole order, any designs mixed.

settings.title: Place your order
settings.text: Log in with your free account only when you send the order, so we know where to deliver.

settings.title: Pay and receive
settings.text: Pay in advance or choose cash on delivery at checkout. We ship with PostEx and send your tracking number.

settings.question: What is the minimum wholesale order?
settings.answer: The minimum is 12 suits for the whole order. You can mix any designs and colours to reach it, for example 4 suits each of 3 designs, and order as many designs as you like.

settings.question: Who can buy wholesale from Sufias Fashion?
settings.answer: Boutiques, shop owners, online sellers and resellers in Pakistan. Browse freely, then log in with a free account when you place your order.

settings.question: Which fabrics and embroidery do you offer?
settings.answer: Embroidered 3-piece suits in winter cotton, khaddar, lawn, chiffon, organza and sheesha silk, with chikankari, thread, cutwork and sequin embroidery. New designs are added every season.

settings.question: Do you deliver wholesale orders across Pakistan?
settings.answer: Yes. Wholesale orders are packed in Lahore and shipped with PostEx to all cities in Pakistan, including Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan and Peshawar. Once your parcel is booked we send you the PostEx tracking number, and you can track it at postex.pk/tracking.

settings.question: How do I pay for a wholesale order?
settings.answer: You can pay in advance by bank transfer, or choose cash on delivery (COD) and pay the PostEx rider when the parcel arrives. For advance payment, send the payment screenshot on WhatsApp. Your orders and payments are recorded in your own account ledger on sufias.com.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: You can return a suit within 3 days of delivery. The suit must not be worn, used or damaged, and must come back in its original packing. Return costs are paid by the owner of the goods, which is the seller of that design. Message us on WhatsApp within 3 days to start a return.

settings.question: How do I track my parcel?
settings.answer: Every wholesale parcel is sent with PostEx. We share your tracking number on WhatsApp and in your order email. Enter it at postex.pk/tracking to see where your parcel is.
